title: Nine Things on a Form
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：activity　|　正文 369 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 activity 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the form asked us to choose, and there were nine ① after-school activities on it and I chose the wrong one, which my father said was the point of a form. Weighing them, he said, is the only ② activity that is never wasted, and he had weighed the same nine things in 1961 and chosen wrong too; an activity, he said, is only a decision with a time on it.

The ③ activity was astronomy, which met on the wrong night, in the wrong room, with one telescope between nine of us, and I went four times and stopped. My mother said an ④ outdoor activity would have kept me, meaning the walking club, and she was right and I have never told her so, and the activity folded in 1988 and nobody said anything about it.

The room where they met was ⑤ full of activity at four o'clock, by which I mean that everybody was doing something and nobody was doing anything, and I have never forgotten the difference. There was ⑥ more activity in that room than in the whole of the rest of the school, and the master in charge said activity is not the same as progress and wrote it on the board.

In 1991 my father's shop closed and the street had ⑦ no economic activity in it at all, which was the phrase the council used, and he said the phrase had been invented so that nobody would have to say his name. He sat in the back for a year with no activity whatever, and then in 1992 there came a ⑧ flurry of activity — nine clocks in four months, every one of them for somebody else — and he said the word had never meant anything to him until then.

The  activity I would choose now, if the form came round again, is not astronomy or the walking club but the year in the back room, four hours a day, one clock at a time, which was the only thing that saved him. An  activity, my father said in 1999, is only ever the shape you give to the time you have been given, and most people are given nine years and use four.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 活跃；活动状态（不可数）
C. n. 热闹；繁忙（的景象）
D. n. （具体一项）活动；项目
E. 固定搭配：after-school / extracurricular activities 课外活动
F. 固定搭配：a flurry / burst of activity 一阵忙碌
G. 固定搭配：outdoor / indoor activities 户外／室内活动
H. 固定搭配：economic / business activity 经济／商业活动

items.q: the only activity that is never wasted
an outdoor activity would have kept me
was full of activity at four o'clock
There was more activity in that room
had no economic activity in it at all
there came a flurry of activity

answers.why: after-school activities 意为“课外活动”，1986 年那张表上有九项课外活动，我选错了。
activity 意为“一项具体的活动、项目”，父亲说权衡取舍是唯一绝不会被浪费的活动。
activity 意为“活动”，我选的那项活动是天文，它在错误的晚上、错误的房间里活动。
outdoor activity 意为“户外活动”，母亲说一项户外活动本可以留住我，她指的是徒步社。
full of activity 意为“热闹非凡、繁忙”，四点钟那间屋子人人在做事，又什么也没做成。
activity 作不可数名词，意为“活跃、活动状态”，那间屋子比全校其他地方都活跃。
economic activity 意为“经济活动”，1991 年那条街上毫无经济活动可言，这是议会的说法。
a flurry of activity 意为“一阵忙碌”，1992 年后屋突然忙碌起来，四个月里修了九只钟，全是给别人修的。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1986 年那张表上有九项课外活动，而我选错了。（after-school activities）
我父亲说，权衡取舍是唯一一样绝不会被浪费的事。（activity）
我选的那项活动是天文社，它在错误的晚上、错误的教室里活动。（activity）
母亲说一项户外活动本可以留住我，她指的是徒步社。（an outdoor activity）
四点钟那间屋子热闹非凡：人人都在做点什么，又什么也没做成。（full of activity）
1991 年父亲的店关了，那条街上毫无商业活动可言。（economic activity）
answers: In 1986 there were nine after-school activities on the form, and I chose the wrong one.
Weighing them, my father said, is the only activity that is never wasted.
The activity was astronomy, and it met on the wrong night in the wrong room.
My mother said an outdoor activity would have kept me, meaning the walking club.
The room was full of activity at four o'clock: everybody was doing something and nobody was doing anything.
In 1991 my father's shop closed and the street had no economic activity in it at all.
